7.7.2 Event memory management
The
event memory
management defines as the process of adding, updating and
removing
event memory entries
in and out of the Dem module. The Dem mod-
ule determines if the
event memory entry
is new or currently exists in the
event
memory
.

but describe the behavior of the ECU towards requests from the test tool.
